text: Current FlavorDataProvider calls saveToFile(destFile.path, attachment.uri), but the second parameter is documented as boolean isTmp. A nonempty URI is truthy and suppresses Saved Files list inclusion; an empty or missing URI does not. Current code still creates and awaits the download in either case. Recommend an explicit boolean and tests for these caller states. This is a static argument-contract concern; no drag or download-list failure was reproduced. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Keep the drag-save argument consistent with the boolean temporary flag
